digest.component_or_area: CLI guide system and documentation links
propositions: CLI-served author guides contain dangling internal cross-references as consumer-relative paths that do not resolve for repo-less clients without a rebar checkout

The commit-trailer format specification (EXPECTED_FORMAT in verify_commit.py) lacks a CLI-discoverable home and is only documented in rebar verify-commit-ticket --help with no pointers from user-facing guide prose

Packaged guides in src/rebar/_guides/ must repoint all repo-relative file references to either rebar explain <topic> for sibling guides or hosted https://github.com/navapbc/rebar URLs for repo-only documentation
A new packaged guide commit-ticket-trailer.md must be registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES and served by rebar explain commit-trailer, with the format quoted verbatim from EXPECTED_FORMAT to prevent drift

Every markdown link target in packaged guides and MCP explain_criterion renderings must be validated by a regression guard test to allow only https://, http://, #anchor, and mailto: formats and reject consumer-relative paths

The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring hardcodes the guide list (plan, review) and must be updated to include commit-trailer alongside a test asserting all AUTHOR_GUIDES keys appear in that docstring
